serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin; each bucket's own table for bookedMin (capacity_bookings source_type=Order, maintenance_bookings, unassigned_services); service_capacities reserved_minutes carried as ledgerBookedMin only.
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin = modelled service minutes set aside for that bucket that day; bookedMin = load from that bucket's authoritative work table; ledgerBookedMin = the capacity ledger's own reserved figure, kept only so its drift stays visible and never used as the booked side; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row for that site and day, not zero capacity.

orderCapacity.note: Static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series: the same ceiling applies to every day of the window until someone edits the lot. daily_order_capacity is the admin UI field "Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity", not an all-order ceiling. null means not configured, not a ceiling of 0.
